length.title: Length Converter: Meters to Feet and Inches
length.metaDesc: Convert between metres, feet, inches, centimetres and kilometres. 1 metre is 3.2808 feet, and every step of the conversion is shown.

pressure-conv.title: Pressure Converter: Pascal, Bar, PSI and kPa
pressure-conv.metaDesc: Convert pressure between pascal, bar, psi, kPa and atmosphere. 1 bar is 14.5038 psi and 1 psi is 6.895 kPa, with the working shown.

temperature.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter (and Kelvin)
temperature.metaDesc: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit and Kelvin, and back. 100 °C is 212 °F and 0 °C is 273.15 K, with the offset and the factor explained.

time-conv.title: Time Converter: Hours, Minutes and Seconds
time-conv.metaDesc: Convert between seconds, minutes, hours and days. 3,600 seconds is 1 hour and 90 minutes is 1.5 hours, with each step of the working shown.

cooking-conv.title: Cups to ml and tbsp to tsp: Cooking Converter
cooking-conv.metaDesc: Convert cups to millilitres, tablespoons to teaspoons and ounces to grams. 1 US cup is about 240 ml and 1 tbsp is exactly 3 tsp.

clothing-size.title: Clothing Size Converter: US to EU, UK and IT
clothing-size.metaDesc: Convert clothing sizes between US, EU, UK and international equivalents — a US women's 10 is about EU 40, with the comparison in one place.

torque-conv.title: Torque Converter: Nm to lb-ft and Other Units
torque-conv.metaDesc: Convert torque between newton-metres, pound-feet and kgf-m. 100 Nm is about 73.8 lb-ft, with the factor and the working shown.

power-conv.title: Watts to Horsepower Converter: W, kW and hp
power-conv.metaDesc: Convert power between watts, kilowatts and horsepower. 100 kW is about 134 hp, and 1 hp is 745.7 watts, with each step shown.

voltage-conv.title: Volts, Amps and Watts Converter: What Converts
voltage-conv.metaDesc: See what converts between volts, amps and watts, and what needs Ohm's law instead — voltage and current are different quantities and cannot be swapped directly.

density-conv.title: Density Converter: kg/m3 to g/cm3 and g/mL
density-conv.metaDesc: Convert density between kg/m3, g/cm3, g/mL and lb/ft3. 1,000 kg/m3 is exactly 1 g/cm3, and the factor is applied to every step.

child-height.title: Child Height Predictor: How Tall Will My Child Be?
child-height.metaDesc: Enter both parents' heights and get your child's predicted adult height in cm and inches using the mid-parental method, as a range rather than a promise.

baby-weight-gain.title: Baby Weight Percentile: Is My Baby on Track for Their Age?
baby-weight-gain.metaDesc: Compare your baby's weight with the average for their age and see the percentage above or below it, plus why a single number is not the whole growth picture.

presentation-time.title: Presentation Time Calculator: How Long Will My Slides Take?
presentation-time.metaDesc: Enter your slide count and minutes per slide to get the speaking time, with a buffer for overruns so a talk fits the slot it was given.

tuition-cost.title: College Tuition Cost Calculator: Cost of a Degree
tuition-cost.metaDesc: Add up cost per credit, total credits and yearly fees to see the full price of a degree, not just the headline tuition figure.

coffee-cost.title: Coffee Cost Calculator: What Your Daily Cup Costs Per Year
coffee-cost.metaDesc: Work out what a coffee habit costs per month and per year from cups per day, price per cup and days a week. A $3 cup five days a week is about $780 a year.

gutter.title: Gutter Calculator: Sections, Length and Downspouts You Need
gutter.metaDesc: Enter the roof perimeter, run length and corners to get the gutter sections and downspouts to order, ready to price against a quote.

gift-wrap.title: How Much Wrapping Paper Do I Need? Box Size Calculator
gift-wrap.metaDesc: Enter the box length, width and height to get the paper area you need for the wrap, with the overlap included so the paper actually covers the box.

drywall.title: Drywall Calculator: How Many Sheets You Need (With Waste)
drywall.metaDesc: Enter the wall area and your sheet size to get the number of drywall sheets to buy, with a 10% waste allowance already included for cuts and mistakes.

baby-feeding.title: Baby Feeding Schedule by Age and Weight: ml Per Feeding
baby-feeding.metaDesc: Estimate how much formula or expressed milk a baby needs per day and per feed from their weight and number of feeds, with the daily total shown.

jet-lag.title: Jet Lag Calculator: Recovery Time, East vs West
jet-lag.metaDesc: Enter the number of time zones crossed and the direction of travel to estimate how many days your body clock needs to adjust, east versus west.

vacation-with-kids.title: Family Vacation Cost Calculator: Budget by Days and Level
vacation-with-kids.metaDesc: Estimate what a family holiday costs from the destination, family size, number of days and budget level, with a per-person daily figure to compare options.

bmr-mifflin.title: BMR Calculator (Mifflin-St Jeor): Daily Calories
bmr-mifflin.metaDesc: Enter weight, height, age and sex to get your basal metabolic rate from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, the one dietitians use most for healthy adults.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator: Last Menstrual Period
pregnancy.metaDesc: Enter the first day of your last menstrual period to get your estimated due date, 40 weeks later by Naegele's rule, with the reasoning spelled out.

deck-stain.title: Deck Stain Calculator: Gallons of Stain or Sealant
deck-stain.metaDesc: Enter the deck length, width and number of coats to get the gallons of stain or sealant to buy, at about 250 sq ft per gallon per coat.

carbon.title: Carbon Footprint Calculator: Home Energy, Gas and Driving
carbon.metaDesc: Estimate your monthly CO2e from electricity, gas and driving, with each source shown separately so you can see which one dominates your footprint.

tip.title: Tip Calculator: Tip Amount, Total and Split per Person
tip.metaDesc: Work out the tip on any bill and split it between people. Enter the bill, the tip percentage and the number of people to get each share.

safe-withdrawal.title: Safe Withdrawal Rate Calculator: Retire on Your Savings
safe-withdrawal.metaDesc: Find the withdrawal rate a portfolio can sustain: enter your savings, the annual withdrawal and the return you expect to see the rate and the years it lasts.

bullet-drop.title: Bullet Drop Calculator: Trajectory, Flight Time, Energy
bullet-drop.metaDesc: Estimate bullet drop over distance from muzzle velocity, ballistic coefficient and sight height, with the time of flight and the remaining energy.

sweat-rate.title: Sweat Rate Calculator: Fluid Loss per Hour of Exercise
sweat-rate.metaDesc: Work out how much fluid you lose per hour of training from your pre- and post-exercise weight, the fluid you drank and the length of the session.

rain-barrel.title: Rain Barrel Calculator: Roof Area to Gallons Harvested
rain-barrel.metaDesc: Work out how much rainwater a roof can harvest. Enter the roof area, the rainfall and the collection efficiency to size the barrel you actually need.

sibling-age-gap.title: Sibling Age Gap Calculator: Months Between Children
sibling-age-gap.metaDesc: Work out the age gap between two children in years, months and days from their birth dates, with the school years they will share.

url-encoder.title: URL Encoder / Decoder: Percent Encoding Online
url-encoder.metaDesc: Encode or decode a URL or query string with percent-encoding. Paste the text, get the escaped result, and copy it straight back into your code.

moon-phase.title: Moon Phase Calculator: Tonight's Phase and Illumination
moon-phase.metaDesc: Find the moon phase for any date, plus the illumination percentage and the days to the next new or full moon, worked out from the lunar cycle.

laundry-cost.title: Laundry Cost Calculator: Cost per Load and per Year
laundry-cost.metaDesc: Work out what washing costs: enter loads per week, washer and dryer energy, water and detergent prices to get the cost per load and per year.

completing-square.title: Completing the Square Calculator: Steps to Vertex Form
completing-square.metaDesc: Turn a quadratic into vertex form by completing the square, with every step shown and the vertex and discriminant reported at the end.

plagiarism-check.title: Citation Checker: Word Count and Citation Density
plagiarism-check.metaDesc: Check a paper's word count against its citation count to see the citations per 1,000 words, with the range most markers expect.

cap-rate-conv.title: Cap Rate to Value Calculator: NOI and Property Value
cap-rate-conv.metaDesc: Convert a cap rate into a property value from the net operating income, or work back from the price to the cap rate, with the formula shown.

financial-need.title: Financial Need Calculator: Cost of Attendance vs EFC
financial-need.metaDesc: Work out a student's financial need from the cost of attendance and the expected family contribution, with the gap an aid office looks at.

carpool-savings.title: Carpool Savings Calculator: Fuel, Tolls, Parking Split
carpool-savings.metaDesc: Work out what carpooling saves: enter the weekly commute cost, the number of riders and the days shared to get the saving per person per month.

cidr-convert.title: CIDR to Subnet Mask Calculator: Hosts and Broadcast
cidr-convert.metaDesc: Convert CIDR notation into a subnet mask, the network and broadcast address, and the usable host range, for IPv4 prefixes.

debt-consolidation.title: Debt Consolidation Calculator: One Payment vs Many
debt-consolidation.metaDesc: Compare a single consolidation loan with your current debts: enter the balances, rates and terms to see the monthly payment and the total interest.

data-center-pue.title: Data Center PUE Calculator: Power Usage Effectiveness
data-center-pue.metaDesc: Work out the power usage effectiveness of a data centre from the total facility power and the IT load, with the overhead split that drives it.

cac-payback.title: CAC Payback Period Calculator: Months to Recover CAC
cac-payback.metaDesc: Work out how many months it takes to recover customer acquisition cost from the gross margin each customer brings in, step by step.

college-cost-planner.title: College Cost Planner: 4-Year Tuition, Room and Board
college-cost-planner.metaDesc: Add up four years of tuition, room, board and fees with an inflation rate applied, to see what a degree will cost by graduation.

grade-needed.title: Final Grade Calculator: Score Needed to Hit Your Target
grade-needed.metaDesc: Work out the score you need on the final exam to reach your target grade, from your current grade, the exam weight and the grade you want.

beam-deflection.title: Beam Deflection Calculator: Simply Supported Beam
beam-deflection.metaDesc: Work out the maximum deflection of a simply supported beam from the load and span, and the modulus and moment of inertia of the section.

childcare-cost.title: Childcare Cost Comparison: Daycare vs Nanny per Year
childcare-cost.metaDesc: Compare daycare, a nanny and a childminder on annual cost from the weekly rate, the number of children and the days you need covered.

appreciation-forecast.title: Property Appreciation Calculator: Future Value by Year
appreciation-forecast.metaDesc: Project a property's value forward from the current price and an annual appreciation rate, with the value and gain shown for each year.

australia-income-tax.title: Australia Income Tax Calculator: Salary and Take-Home
australia-income-tax.metaDesc: Work out Australian income tax, the Medicare levy and take-home pay from your salary, with the brackets and thresholds set out clearly.

cash-on-cash.title: Cash-on-Cash Return Calculator: Rental Property ROI
cash-on-cash.metaDesc: Work out the cash-on-cash return on a rental from the annual pre-tax cash flow and the cash you actually invested, with the formula shown.

coupon-payment.title: Bond Coupon Payment Calculator: Annual and Semi-Annual
coupon-payment.metaDesc: Work out the coupon payment on a bond from its face value, coupon rate and payment frequency, with the annual total alongside it.

haircut-annual.title: Haircut Cost Calculator: What a Year of Cuts Costs
haircut-annual.metaDesc: Work out the yearly cost of haircuts from the price per visit, how often you go and the tip percentage, with the monthly figure alongside.

statistics.title: Statistics Calculator: Mean, Median & Standard Deviation
statistics.metaDesc: Paste a data set and get the mean, median and standard deviation in one pass, with the count and sum shown and every step of the working laid out.

mean-median-mode.title: Mean Median Mode Calculator: Averages From One Data Set
mean-median-mode.metaDesc: Work out the mean, median and mode of a list of numbers together, with the sorted data shown. The defaults give a mean of 5.00, median 4.5 and mode 4.

variance-sd.title: Variance & Standard Deviation Calculator: Data Set
variance-sd.metaDesc: Calculate the variance and standard deviation of a data set as a population or a sample, with the mean, every squared deviation and each step shown.

harmonic-mean.title: Harmonic Mean Calculator: Data Set & Reciprocals
harmonic-mean.metaDesc: Find the harmonic mean of a data set by the reciprocal method, with every reciprocal and the final division shown. The defaults give 3.4286.

standard-error.title: Standard Error of the Mean (SEM): Formula and Example
standard-error.metaDesc: Work out the standard error of the mean from a data set, with the standard deviation, the sample size and the final division all shown step by step.

coefficient-of-variation.title: Coefficient of Variation Calculator: Relative Spread
coefficient-of-variation.metaDesc: Work out the coefficient of variation from a data set, the standard deviation as a share of the mean, so the spread of two data sets can be compared.

quartile.title: Quartile & IQR Calculator: Q1, Q2, Q3 and the Range
quartile.metaDesc: Find Q1, Q2, Q3 and the interquartile range from a data set, with the sorted list and the position each quartile lands on shown step by step.

password-gen.title: Password Generator: Strong Random Passwords
password-gen.metaDesc: Generate a strong random password at the length you choose, with symbols and numbers optional. Everything runs in the browser and nothing is sent anywhere.

waist-height-ratio.title: Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator (WHtR): Waist & Height
waist-height-ratio.metaDesc: Work out the waist-to-height ratio from a waist and height in centimetres, with the 0.5 cut-off explained. The page defaults give WHtR = 0.47.

clean-dirty-price.title: Clean vs Dirty Bond Price: Clean Price & Accrued Interest
clean-dirty-price.metaDesc: Work out the clean price of a bond from its dirty (full) price and the accrued interest, with the defaults giving $1,016.50 and the subtraction shown.

saudi-take-home-salary.title: Saudi Arabia (KSA) Take-Home Salary Calculator: Net Pay
saudi-take-home-salary.metaDesc: Work out Saudi net pay from gross salary, with GOSI contributions, zero income tax and a monthly take-home breakdown for expats and nationals.

ideal-body-weight.title: Ideal Body Weight (IBW) Calculator: Devine Formula
ideal-body-weight.metaDesc: Estimate ideal body weight (IBW) from height with the Devine formula, shown beside the healthy weight range and every step of the working.

total-body-water.title: Total Body Water (TBW) Calculator: Weight & Height
total-body-water.metaDesc: Estimate total body water in litres from weight, height, age and sex, with the share of body weight and every step of the working shown.

light-bulb-save.title: LED Light Bulb Savings Calculator: Watts & Annual Saving
light-bulb-save.metaDesc: Compare the bulbs you run now with LEDs: running cost per year and the saving, from wattage, hours used and your electricity rate.

proportion.title: Proportion Calculator: Solve a/b = c/d for the Unknown
proportion.metaDesc: Proportion Calculator solves a ÷ b = c ÷ d for whichever term is missing, using cross multiplication and showing each step of the working.

peptide-reconstitution.title: Peptide Reconstitution Calculator: Concentration & Units
peptide-reconstitution.metaDesc: Work out peptide concentration from the vial amount and diluent volume, then the volume and syringe units for an amount per dose. Arithmetic only.

pet-food-cost.title: Pet Food Cost Calculator: Monthly Food and Vet Costs
pet-food-cost.metaDesc: Add up food, treats, vet care and supplies to see what a pet really costs each month, then the yearly and lifetime totals. Free, and nothing is uploaded.

json-formatter.title: JSON Formatter: Pretty-Print, Minify and Validate
json-formatter.metaDesc: Paste JSON to pretty-print, minify or validate it in your browser. You get clean indented output and any parse error named — nothing is uploaded.

dew-point.title: Dew Point Calculator: When Will Condensation Form?
dew-point.metaDesc: Enter air temperature and relative humidity to get the dew point with the Magnus formula. At 30 °C and 70% humidity it is 23.9 °C, where condensation starts.

auto-fare.title: Auto Fare Meaning: Base Fare Plus Per-km Rate
auto-fare.metaDesc: An auto fare is a fixed base charge plus a rate for every kilometre. Enter distance, base fare and per-km rate to get the total, with the arithmetic shown.

keyword-density.title: Keyword Density Formula: Occurrences ÷ Words × 100
keyword-density.metaDesc: Density is keyword occurrences divided by total words, times 100. Paste text and a keyword to get the percentage and the 1-3% range usually cited.

leap-year.title: How Is a Leap Year Calculated? The ÷4 Rule
leap-year.metaDesc: A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, except century years, which must divide by 400. Enter a year to see the rule applied step by step.

weight.title: Weight Converter: kg to lbs and Other Units
weight.metaDesc: Convert weight between kilograms, pounds, ounces and grams. 1 kilogram is 2.20462 pounds, and the factor and the working are shown at each step.

volume.title: Volume Converter: Litres to Gallons and More
volume.metaDesc: Convert volume between litres, millilitres, US gallons and fluid ounces. 1 litre is 0.2642 US gallons, with each conversion step shown.

area.title: Area Converter: m² to ft² and Other Units
area.metaDesc: Convert area between square metres, square feet, acres and hectares. 1 square metre is 10.7639 square feet, with the factor shown.

speed.title: Speed Converter: km/h to mph and m/s
speed.metaDesc: Convert speed between km/h, mph, m/s and knots. 100 km/h is 62.14 mph, and 1 mph is about 1.609 km/h going the other way.

data-storage.title: Data Storage Converter: GB to MB, KB and Bytes
data-storage.metaDesc: Convert data sizes between bytes, kilobytes, megabytes and gigabytes. 1 gigabyte is 1,024 megabytes on the binary scale most systems report.

angle.title: Angle Converter: Degrees to Radians and Gradians
angle.metaDesc: Convert angles between degrees, radians, gradians and turns. 90 degrees is 1.5708 radians, and a full turn is 360 degrees or 2π radians.

energy.title: Energy Converter: Joules, kWh, Calories and BTU
energy.metaDesc: Convert energy between joules, kilojoules, kilowatt-hours, calories and BTU. 1 kWh is 3.6 million joules, or about 3,412 BTU.

frequency-conv.title: Frequency Converter: Hz, kHz, MHz and GHz
frequency-conv.metaDesc: Convert frequency between hertz, kilohertz, megahertz and gigahertz. 1 MHz is 1,000,000 Hz, and 1 GHz is 1,000 MHz.

force-conv.title: Force Converter: Newtons to lbf and kgf
force-conv.metaDesc: Convert force between newtons, kilonewtons, pound-force and kilogram-force. 100 newtons is 22.48 lbf, because 1 N is 0.224809 lbf.

fuel-efficiency-converter.title: Fuel Efficiency Converter: L/100km to MPG
fuel-efficiency-converter.metaDesc: Convert fuel economy between litres per 100 km, miles per gallon (US and UK) and km per litre. 10 L/100 km is about 23.5 mpg US.

radiation-conv.title: Radiation Converter: Sv, mSv, Gy and rem
radiation-conv.metaDesc: Convert radiation between sieverts, millisieverts, grays and rem. 1 sievert is 1,000 millisieverts, with absorbed and equivalent dose kept apart.

bit-rate-conv.title: Bit Rate Converter: Mbps to kbps and Gbps
bit-rate-conv.metaDesc: Convert data transfer rates between bits, kilobits, megabits and gigabits per second. 1 megabit per second is 1,000 kilobits per second.

luminance-conv.title: Luminance Converter: Lux to Foot-candles
luminance-conv.metaDesc: Convert light levels between lux and foot-candles. 1 foot-candle is 10.7639 lux, so 500 lux is about 46.5 foot-candles.

molarity-conv.title: Molarity Converter: Molar to Millimolar
molarity-conv.metaDesc: Convert concentration between molar, millimolar and micromolar. 1 molar is 1,000 millimolar, and the same factor applies at every step.

flow-rate-conv.title: Flow Rate Converter: L/s to m³/h and GPM
flow-rate-conv.metaDesc: Convert flow rate between litres per second, cubic metres per hour and gallons per minute. 1 litre per second is 3.6 m³/h.

roman-numeral.title: Roman Numeral Converter: Numbers to Roman Numerals
roman-numeral.metaDesc: Convert between numbers and Roman numerals. 1,000 is M, 500 is D, 4 is IV and 9 is IX, with the subtractive rules applied in order.

ppm-conv.title: PPM Converter: ppm to ppb and Percent
ppm-conv.metaDesc: Convert concentration between ppm, ppb, percent and parts per thousand. 1 ppm is 1,000 ppb, and 10,000 ppm is 1 percent.

thermal-conductivity.title: Thermal Conductivity Converter: W/m·K to BTU
thermal-conductivity.metaDesc: Convert thermal conductivity between W/(m·K), BTU/(ft·h·°F) and kcal/(h·m·°C). 1 W/(m·K) is about 0.578 BTU/(ft·h·°F).

radiation-dose-conv.title: Radiation Dose Converter: Gray to Rad
radiation-dose-conv.metaDesc: Convert absorbed radiation dose between gray, rad, sievert and rem. 1 gray is 100 rad, and 1 sievert is 100 rem.

acceleration-conv.title: Acceleration Converter: m/s² to g-force
acceleration-conv.metaDesc: Convert acceleration between m/s², g-force, ft/s² and Gal. 1 g is 9.80665 m/s², so 9.81 m/s² is very close to one g.

dbm-watts.title: dBm to Watts Converter: dBm ↔ W and mW
dbm-watts.metaDesc: Convert between dBm and watts. 30 dBm is 1 watt and 0 dBm is 1 milliwatt, on the logarithmic scale used for radio and audio power.

unit-converter.title: Universal Unit Converter: Length, Mass and More
unit-converter.metaDesc: Convert between length, mass, volume, temperature and more in one place. 1 m is 3.2808 ft and 1 kg is 2.2046 lb, with each factor shown.

fraction-percent.title: Fraction to Percent to Decimal Converter
fraction-percent.metaDesc: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages. 3/4 is 0.75 and 75%, and the tool shows the numerator and denominator behind it.

scientific-notation.title: Scientific Notation Converter: Decimal to Scientific
scientific-notation.metaDesc: Convert between decimal and scientific notation. 0.000123 is 1.23 × 10⁻⁴, and the converter keeps the significant figures you enter.

polar-rect.title: Polar ↔ Rectangular Coordinates Converter
polar-rect.metaDesc: Convert between polar and rectangular coordinates. A polar point of r = 5 at 30° is x = 4.3301 and y = 2.5 in rectangular form.

annulus-area.title: Annulus (Ring) Area Calculator: Outer Radius & Inner Radius
annulus-area.metaDesc: Find the area of a ring (annulus) from its outer and inner radius. An outer radius of 8 and an inner radius of 5 give about 122.52 square units.

wavelength-freq.title: Wavelength ↔ Frequency: Light & Wave Physics
wavelength-freq.metaDesc: Convert between wavelength and frequency using c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s. A 550 nm wave of light is about 5.45 × 10¹⁴ Hz.

mole-conversion.title: Mole Conversion Calculator: Mass & Molar Mass
mole-conversion.metaDesc: Convert between mass, moles and molar mass using moles = mass ÷ molar mass. 18 g of water at 18 g/mol is 1 mole, with each step shown.

currency-converter.title: Currency Converter — USD to PKR Exchange Rates
currency-converter.metaDesc: Convert between currencies using live exchange rates covering 150+ pairs, from USD to PKR, EUR, GBP and more.

salary-converter.title: Salary Converter: Hourly, Monthly and Annual Pay
salary-converter.metaDesc: Convert a salary between hourly, monthly and annual figures. $50,000 a year is about $4,167 a month and $24.04 an hour at 40 hours a week.

currency-conv.title: Currency Converter: Fixed Exchange Rate Calculator
currency-conv.metaDesc: Convert between currencies at a fixed exchange rate you set. Enter an amount and the rate to get the converted figure with the working shown.

paper-size-conv.title: Paper Size Converter: A4, A5, B5 Dimensions
paper-size-conv.metaDesc: Convert between A, B and C series paper sizes. A4 is 210 × 297 mm and A5 is half that at 148 × 210 mm, with each step shown.

cooking.title: Cooking Converter: Cups, ml, tbsp and tsp
cooking.metaDesc: Convert cooking measurements between cups, millilitres, tablespoons and teaspoons. 1 US cup is about 240 ml and 1 tbsp is exactly 3 tsp.

prime-factor.title: Prime Factorization Calculator: Factor Any Number
prime-factor.metaDesc: Break any whole number into its prime factors. 360 is 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5, and the tool shows each division of the working.

significant-figures.title: Significant Figures Calculator: Rounding and Sig Figs
significant-figures.metaDesc: Round a number to a chosen number of significant figures. 0.004567 to two significant figures is 0.0046, with the counting rule shown.

digital-root.title: Digital Root Calculator: Repeated Digit Sum
digital-root.metaDesc: Find the digital root of a number by repeatedly summing its digits. The digital root of 9,876 is 3, since 9+8+7+6 = 30 and 3+0 = 3.

gst-india.title: GST Calculator India: Add or Remove GST
gst-india.metaDesc: Add or remove GST at any rate. ₹10,000 plus 18% GST is ₹11,800, and the tool shows the base, the tax and the total separately.

uae-vat.title: UAE VAT Calculator: Add or Remove 5% VAT
uae-vat.metaDesc: Add or remove 5% VAT. AED 1,000 plus 5% VAT is AED 1,050, and the tool shows the base amount and the tax separately.

maintenance-fluids.title: Maintenance Fluids Calculator (4-2-1 Rule)
maintenance-fluids.metaDesc: Calculate paediatric maintenance fluids with the 4-2-1 rule: 4 ml/kg/hr for the first 10 kg, 2 for the next 10 kg and 1 for each kg after that.

vector-add.title: Vector Addition Calculator: Sum of Two Vectors
vector-add.metaDesc: Add two vectors component by component to get their sum. Enter the x, y and z components of each vector and the result is shown step by step.

date-add.title: Date Add/Subtract: Start Date & Days
date-add.metaDesc: Add or subtract days from a date. Starting from 15 January 2026 and adding 90 days gives 15 April 2026, with the day count shown.

salary-hourly.title: Salary to Hourly Converter: Annual Salary & Hours/Week
salary-hourly.metaDesc: Convert an annual salary into an hourly rate. $80,000 a year at 40 hours a week for 52 weeks is about $38.46 an hour.

protein-need.title: Daily Protein Intake Calculator: Grams per Day
protein-need.metaDesc: Work out a daily protein target in grams from your body weight and activity level, with the grams-per-kilogram rule shown.

vegan-protein.title: Vegan Protein Sources: How Much You Need
vegan-protein.metaDesc: How much protein a plant-based diet needs, and which foods supply it. Enter your weight to get a daily gram target with the sources listed.

carbon-dating.title: Carbon Dating Calculator: How Old Is Your Sample?
carbon-dating.metaDesc: Enter the share of carbon-14 remaining to get the sample age. C-14 has a 5,730-year half-life, and the decay maths is shown step by step.

charging-time.title: Phone Charging Time Calculator: Minutes to Full
charging-time.metaDesc: Enter battery capacity, charger wattage and the charge range to get the time. A 5,000 mAh phone going from 20% to 80% on 18 W takes about 44 minutes.

rgb-hex.title: RGB to Hex Converter: Pick a Colour, Copy the Code
rgb-hex.metaDesc: Convert RGB values to a hex code and back. Enter 79, 70 and 229 to get #4F46E5, with each channel hex pair explained along the way.

wire-gauge-conv.title: AWG to mm Converter: Wire Gauge Diameter and Area
wire-gauge-conv.metaDesc: Convert American Wire Gauge to diameter in millimetres and cross-section in mm². 14 AWG is 1.628 mm across and 2.08 mm², with the formula shown.

solar-energy.title: Solar Panel Output Calculator: kWh per Day and Month
solar-energy.metaDesc: Enter panel count, wattage, peak sun hours and system efficiency to see daily, monthly and yearly kWh. Twenty 350 W panels at 5 sun hours give 29.8 kWh a day.

ip-subnet.title: IP Subnet Calculator: Network, Broadcast and Hosts
ip-subnet.metaDesc: Enter an IPv4 address and prefix length to get the network address, broadcast address, usable host range and mask. 192.168.1.10/24 sits in 192.168.1.0.

prorated-rent.title: Prorated Rent Calculator: Pay Only for Days Used
prorated-rent.metaDesc: Work out rent for part of a month from monthly rent, days occupied and days in the month. Staying 15 of 30 days at $1,200 means $600, shown step by step.

trigonometry.title: Trigonometry Calculator: Sin, Cos and Tan of an Angle
trigonometry.metaDesc: Enter an angle in degrees to get its sine, cosine and tangent. At 45 degrees sin and cos are both 0.7071 and tan is 1, with the radian conversion shown first.
